column1: # Unknown sections draw one diagnostic each, however many headers; their plain keys draw none.
# Unknown keys in a section the table reads draw one each. A key naming a retired or non-canonical
# concept (by any alias, under the schema normalisation), or spelled as the schema's
# non_canonical_keys lists (a deadzone, a response curve, a unit scale, an axis sign), says so in
# any section. So does every other key in a section a non_canonical_keys group lists
# ([Sensitivity], [Deadzone]), whatever it is spelled. So does a key naming a row of the table in
# another section, or a concept row by an alias: it names the row. [CameraUnlock] keys are core's
# and draw nothing. A concept key this table does not bind is an unknown key.
